channels.name: TX0+ / TX0-
channels.purpose: Channel 0 — Blue pixel byte during DE=high; {VSYNC,HSYNC} control character during DE=low.

channels.name: TX1+ / TX1-
channels.purpose: Channel 1 — Green pixel byte during DE=high; {CTL[1],0} control character during DE=low.

channels.name: TX2+ / TX2-
channels.purpose: Channel 2 — Red pixel byte during DE=high; {CTL[3]=0,CTL[2]} control character during DE=low.

channels.name: TXC+ / TXC-
channels.purpose: Differential pixel clock; receiver recovers bit clock by 10× PLL on TXC.

channels.name: IDCK+ / IDCK-
channels.purpose: Input pixel clock; single-ended (IDCK- tied LOW) OR fully differential (low-swing only).
channels.active_levels: high-swing 3.3 V CMOS or low-swing 1.1-1.8 V

channels.name: DATA[23:0]
channels.purpose: 24-bit pixel data (or 12-bit dual-edge on DATA[11:0]); latched on IDCK edge.

channels.name: DE
channels.purpose: Data Enable; HIGH=active video, LOW=blanking.

channels.name: HSYNC
channels.purpose: Horizontal sync; embedded into Channel 0 control character during blanking.

channels.name: VSYNC
channels.purpose: Vertical sync; embedded into Channel 0 control character during blanking.

channels.name: CTL3/DK3/A3 (pin 6)
channels.purpose: Multi-function input: CTL[3] data (always 0 for HDCP), DK[3] de-skew trim, A3 I2C address bit.

channels.name: BSEL/SCL (pin 15)
channels.purpose: Bus-width select (ISEL=0) or I2C clock (ISEL=1).

channels.name: DSEL/SDA (pin 14)
channels.purpose: Clock-mode select (ISEL=0) or I2C data (ISEL=1).

channels.name: EDGE/HTPLG (pin 9)
channels.purpose: Latch-edge select (ISEL=0) or Hot-Plug Detect input (ISEL=1).

channels.name: ISEL/RST (pin 13)
channels.purpose: I2C select (HIGH=I2C enabled) and asynchronous reset (LOW pulse resets registers).

channels.name: DKEN (pin 35)
channels.purpose: De-skew enable.

channels.name: PD (pin 10)
channels.purpose: Power-down, active-low (ISEL=0 path); register CTL_1_MODE.PD (ISEL=1).

channels.name: VREF (pin 3)
channels.purpose: Input reference voltage; selects high-swing vs low-swing input mode.

channels.name: MSEN/PO1 (pin 11)
channels.purpose: Monitor sense / programmable output; outputs RSEN/HTPLG/MDI per MSEL.

channels.name: TFADJ (pin 19)
channels.purpose: Full-scale current adjust; external R_TFADJ resistor sets V_SWING.

channels.name: RESERVED (pin 34)
channels.purpose: Tie to GND for normal operation.

channels.name: HPD (system level, on receiver)
channels.purpose: Hot-Plug Detect line — receiver drives HIGH (3.3 V) when connected and powered.

logical_signaling_levels.name: TMDS_HIGH
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Single-ended HIGH on TX+ (low on TX-) → differential HIGH

logical_signaling_levels.name: TMDS_LOW
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Single-ended LOW on TX+ (high on TX-) → differential LOW

logical_signaling_levels.name: TMDS_OFF
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Driver off; differential = 0; receiver sees idle

logical_signaling_levels.name: I2C_HIGH
logical_signaling_levels.SDA/SCL: open-drain released; pulled HIGH by external R

logical_signaling_levels.name: I2C_LOW
logical_signaling_levels.SDA/SCL: pulled LOW by master or slave

members: 0x2AB (VSYNC=1,HSYNC=1) on Channel 0; analogous CTL codes on Channels 1 and 2

packet_types_summary.class: Video preamble + guard band + data island (HDMI-only)

global_signals: ISEL/RST — asynchronous reset and I2C mode select

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_TMDS_symbol: LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 9 last) per channel.
ordering_rules.channel_order_per_pixel: TX0 (Blue) + TX1 (Green) + TX2 (Red) transmitted simultaneously, one pixel per IDCK period.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_I2C_transaction: sub-address auto-increments after each data byte (write or read).
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: TMDS is unidirectional (source → sink); I2C is bidirectional half-duplex; never both ends TMDS-driving.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Source drives IDCK + DATA + DE + sync + CTL; TFP410 encodes per pixel, serializes onto 3 data pairs + 1 clock pair; receiver decodes synchronously on TXC.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each pixel's R/G/B independently maps to TX2/TX1/TX0; each channel's encoding is stateful via per-channel running disparity.

handshake_pairs.name: PLL_LOCK
handshake_pairs.rule: PD=1 → PLL begins locking to IDCK; lock signals internal TMDS enable.

handshake_pairs.name: HPD_ASSERT
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver drives HPD HIGH when ready; source observes via HTPLG pin.

handshake_pairs.name: RSEN_SENSE
handshake_pairs.rule: Source-side passive current sense on TX0; RSEN=1 → powered receiver.

handshake_pairs.name: DDC_EDID_READ
handshake_pairs.rule: Standard I2C read at 0xA0; receiver returns 128/256/512 EDID bytes.

handshake_pairs.name: I2C_REG_RW
handshake_pairs.rule: Standard I2C write/read on SCL/SDA; auto-increment sub-address.
